name: Hall of Mosses
why: A short loop through the Hoh Rain Forest, under maples and spruces hung with curtains of moss, in one of the wettest places in the country.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. The road to the Hoh visitor centre often has a long queue in summer: arrive before 10:00.
dangers: Roots and wet boardwalk are slippery.
Elk in the forest: keep 25 m away.

points.name: Hoh Rain Forest Visitor Center
points.note: The end of the Upper Hoh Road, 50 km from Forks.

points.name: Hall of Mosses
points.note: Bigleaf maples draped in club moss, the heart of the rain forest.

points.name: Old-growth Sitka spruces
points.note: The way back, under spruces 70 m tall that sprouted on fallen 'nurse logs'.
